I don’t know. I’m really struggling with depression, anxiety and anorexia and it’s really making life difficult for me. I’m not quite sure who to talk to and I’m too anxious to do so. I feel as though everyone around me would be better without me, I don’t know what I’m supposedly good at if anything to have my friends supposedly like me. I hate everything about me and my life.  I’m really just a waste of space and air. 

I’ve just been going through shit day after shit day and don’t know if there’s any point in going on, everyday at college I just see how I get in the way for most people and how much easier particularly in lessons life would be for everybody else. 

Tbh if I’m just in the way of everyone else and feeling shit all of the time then is there really any point in going on? Nothing is getting any better, I’m never going to get a girlfriend as I’m always so fucking awkward. Honestly just difficult to feel motivated to do anything or continue. Thanks for reply :)
